create_llvm_env_for_codesize: create an LLVM environment optimized for code size using OptimizationTarget.CODESIZE.make_env with a benchmark
create_llvm_env_for_binsize: create an LLVM environment optimized for binary size using OptimizationTarget.BINSIZE.make_env with a benchmark
create_llvm_env_for_runtime: create an LLVM environment optimized for runtime using OptimizationTarget.RUNTIME.make_env with a benchmark
compute_final_reward: compute the final reward of an LLVM environment using OptimizationTarget.final_reward to measure optimization quality
get_optimization_space_enum_name: get the optimization space enum name from an OptimizationTarget using the optimization_space_enum_name property
